The '''Ursellin system''' was located in the [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the "[[Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings]]," a notable exploit of the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]] and the criminal organization "[[Red & Black League]]."<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ursellin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-13.<ref name="TEA" />
